reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithWeekendRule for the move, but parses days with new Date(`${day}T00:00:00`) instead of monthUtils.parseDate and re-writes the daily weekend-skip test instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The daily-schedule skip condition (frequency === 'daily' && skipWeekend && isWeekend) is a copy of the inline check in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, so the rule now lives in two places.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way, but the daily-skip decision belongs in shared/schedules.ts with the other weekend rule helpers.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: A future change to the daily-skip rule must be made in both getNextDate and getDatesInRange; the unexplained 3-day padding and the missing captureBreadcrumb error handling of its sibling also diverge.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The weekend move goes through getDateWithWeekendRule; there was no shared daily-skip helper to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange: the getNextDate daily weekend skip is rewritten as an isDaily flag plus a flatMap early return rather than extracted into a shared function.
